Apply to the affected area 1 or several times (a number of times) a day.
entries.1회 15 mL 1일 2회 약 1분 동안 양치질하고, 의치로 인한 구내염: Rinse the mouth with 15 mL per dose for about 1 minute, 2 times a day; in the case of stomatitis caused by dentures, soak and clean the dentures for 15 minutes 2 times a day. Increase or decrease the amount appropriately according to age and symptoms.
entries.1회 적량인 약 0.3 g (약 0.5 cm)을 칫솔에 묻혀 1일 2회(: Put about 0.3 g (about 0.5 cm), the appropriate amount for 1 application, on a toothbrush and massage the gums 2 times a day (morning and evening). The mouth may be rinsed lightly with water after use.
entries.가려움, 발적, 발진, 접촉피부염, 습진, 부기, 열감, 종창, 홍조,: If itching, redness, rash, contact dermatitis, eczema, swelling, a feeling of heat, tumefaction, flushing, anaphylactic symptoms, photosensitivity, a burning sensation, irritation, dryness or numbness, gastrointestinal discomfort, headache, dizziness, hypersensitivity reactions (skin reactions, bronchospasm, a drop in blood pressure leading to shock and the like), or in special cases aseptic meningitis (headache, nausea, vomiting, fever, stiffness of the back of the neck or clouding of consciousness) occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.국소 및 전신 알레르기 증상(때때로 발진, 두드러기), 접촉성 습진, 드: If local and systemic allergic symptoms (occasionally rash or hives), contact eczema, rarely shock symptoms (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), photosensitisation or the like occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.국소 알레르기, 접촉성 습진, 전신 알레르기, 쇽 증상(구역, 불쾌감,: If local allergy, contact eczema, systemic allergy, shock symptoms (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), rash, hives, photosensitisation or the like occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not use it together with other chemicals or cleansing agents.
entries.드물게 쇽 (예: 구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란,: If shock occurs rarely (for example nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), or if hypersensitivity such as rash or hives occurs occasionally, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Fatal anaphylactic shock of unknown frequency and photosensitisation may occur.
entries.드물게 쇽 증상(호흡곤란, 조홍, 두드러기 가려움, 부종, 가슴 쓰림과: If shock symptoms occur rarely (difficulty breathing, flushing, hives with itching, oedema, heartburn together with pallor, coldness of the hands and feet, cold sweat and shortness of breath), or if iodine rash, a burning sensation, skin ulcers or contact dermatitis occur, or occasionally pain, itching, irritation, redness or dermatitis, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.드물게 쇽(구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란, 발적): If shock occurs rarely (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), if hypersensitivity such as rash or hives occurs occasionally, or if fatal anaphylactic shock of unknown frequency occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitisation may occur.
entries.드물게 쇽, 구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란, 발적: If shock, nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing or redness occurs rarely, or if rash or hives occurs occasionally, or if anaphylactic shock of unknown frequency occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.매우 흔하게 일시적 적용부위 자극감이나 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐), 드물게: If very commonly a temporary feeling of irritation or redness (congested and reddened skin) at the application site occurs, or rarely hypersensitivity reactions at the application site including dermatitis, pain, itching, erythema, rash or a burning sensation of the skin, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.미온수 1 리터 당 이 약 분말 16.2 g 을 넣고, 완전히 녹을 때까: Add 16.2 g of the powder of this medicine per 1 litre of lukewarm water and prepare the solution by stirring intermittently for at least 15 minutes until it is completely dissolved. Use this medicine in the following order. Wash the instruments to be sterilised first, then immerse them completely in this activated solution and leave them soaking for 10 minutes. Keep the container of this solution closed during use. After the recommended contact time has elapsed, rinse the medical devices with water of at least drinking-water quality and dry them. The solution must be prepared daily and must be replaced immediately if it becomes contaminated.
entries.발진·발적, 가려움 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If rash, redness or itching occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.소독할 면적의 크기에 따라 제품을 선택하십시오.넓은 수술부위(목부위부터: Choose the product according to the size of the area to be disinfected. For a large surgical site (from the neck to the groin) use the 26 mL preparation, and for a small surgical site use the 6 mL preparation. Both the 26 mL and the 6 mL preparations are for single use only, that is 1 use each.
entries.시메티딘, 프로프라놀롤, 이뇨제와 함께 사용 시 의사 또는 약사와 상의하: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when it is used together with cimetidine, propranolol or diuretics.
entries.양치 후 1일 3~4회(식사 후), 3~4주간, 모든 증상이 소실될 때까: After brushing the teeth, use it continuously 3 to 4 times a day (after meals) for 3 to 4 weeks, until all symptoms have disappeared. Rinse the mouth with about 10 mL for 1 to 2 minutes, and do not dilute it before use.
entries.용도에 따라 다음의 농도로 희석하여 사용합니다.손 및 피부의 소독 시 0: Dilute to the following concentrations according to the intended use. For disinfection of the hands and skin, wash for about 5 minutes with a 0.05 to 0.2 % aqueous solution and then wipe clean with sterile gauze or cloth. For disinfection of the skin at the surgical site, wash the skin surface to be operated on with a 0.1 % aqueous solution for about 5 minutes and then apply a 0.2 % aqueous solution. For disinfection of the mucous membranes at the surgical site and for disinfection of wounded areas of the skin and mucous membranes, use a 0.1 to 0.05 % aqueous solution. For disinfection of medical devices, immerse them in a 0.05 to 0.2 % aqueous solution for 10 to 15 minutes; however, for disinfection related to tuberculosis patients use a 0.2 to 0.5 % aqueous solution. For disinfection of operating room and ward furniture, instruments and articles, use a 0.05 % to 0.2 % aqueous solution; however, for disinfection related to tuberculosis patients use a 0.2 to 0.5 % aqueous solution.
entries.이 약 5 mL을 젖은 손에 덜어 30초간 씻은 후 물로 깨끗이 세척하고: Pour 5 mL of this medicine onto wet hands, wash for 30 seconds, then rinse thoroughly with water and dry completely.
entries.이 약 조제 시 미온수 1리터당 이 약 분말 16.2 g을 넣고 분말이: When preparing this medicine, add 16.2 g of the powder of this medicine per 1 litre of lukewarm water and mix well until the powder is completely dissolved into a clear blue-green solution. Activation takes 15 minutes, and after about 30 minutes the solution turns colourless. After washing the instruments to be sterilised thoroughly, immerse them completely in this activated solution and leave them soaking for 10 minutes. Rinse the instruments completely with sterile water so that no solution remains. Use them after drying, or store them by an appropriate method.
entries.이 약에 과민증 경험자, 뇌, 척수, 귀, 질, 방광, 구강 등의 점막면: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it, and do not use it on the brain, spinal cord, ear, vagina, bladder, oral cavity or other mucosal surfaces, or on the eyes. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have hypersensitivity to other medicines, if you are a patient with an allergic disease such as asthma or a history or family history of one, or if it is to be applied around the vulva immediately before delivery. Use it externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. When it is used over a wide area or for a long period, take care not to inhale the vapour. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Do not use it for obstetric and gynaecological purposes (such as disinfection of the vagina and vulva) or for urological purposes (such as disinfection of the external genitalia and mucosal surfaces). When disinfecting instruments that may come into contact with nerves or mucosal surfaces, such as syringes and catheters, rinse them thoroughly with sterile water before use. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands and similar purposes with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 경험자는 사용하지 마십시오.다른 약물에 과민증 환자, 천: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are a patient with hypersensitivity to other medicines, a patient with an allergic disease such as asthma or a history or family history of one, a woman who is pregnant or may be pregnant, or a breastfeeding woman. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. Contact with the eyes may cause serious corneal damage that can require a corneal transplant (corneal erosion, epithelial defect / corneal damage, severe permanent visual impairment), so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. Anions contained in saline and similar solutions form poorly soluble salts, so use clean distilled water when diluting it. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands and similar purposes with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 2개월 이하의 영아, 뇌, 척수, 눈, 귀(내이,: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it or in infants aged 2 months or younger, and do not use it on the brain, spinal cord, eyes, ears (inner, middle or outer ear) or mucous membranes (especially genital mucosa). Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have an allergic constitution, if it is to be applied to broken skin (especially burns), mucous membranes or large areas of immature skin, or if you have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to Yellow No. 5. Use it externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Do not use it to disinfect surgical instruments. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. Do not use it in the eyes.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 만 12세 이하의 소아는 이 약을 투여하지 마십시: Do not administer this medicine to patients with hypersensitivity to it or to children aged 12 years or younger. After rinsing the mouth, spit it out and do not swallow it.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.벗겨지거나 손상된 피부: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not apply it to broken or damaged skin or to recently shaved areas. It must be used only on the area to be treated, and the application area must be kept completely dry. Take care that it does not touch the eyes or mucous membranes. Bathing must be avoided immediately before applying this medicine and must also be avoided for one hour after application. Do not remove underarm hair within 12 hours before or after applying this medicine.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약은 벗겨지거나 손: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not apply this medicine to broken or damaged skin or to recently shaved areas. It must be used only on the area to be treated, and the application area must be kept completely dry. Take care that it does not touch the eyes or mucous membranes. Bathing must be avoided immediately before applying this medicine, and at least one hour must have passed after application. Do not remove underarm hair within 12 hours before or after applying this medicine.
This medicine is used for hyperhidrosis (excessive sweating) of the armpits, hands and feet.
This medicine is used for the bactericidal disinfection of scratches, cuts and wound surfaces.
entries.이 약은 보철(의치)에 의한 염증, 아구창 등의 구강내 칸디다감염증, 치: This medicine is used to relieve inflammation caused by prostheses (dentures), oral candidiasis such as thrush, gingivitis, pharyngitis and aphthous stomatitis, and for bactericidal disinfection after periodontal ligament surgery.
entries.이 약은 수술 전 환자의 피부소독, 주사기 바늘, 카테타 삽입 전 환자의: This medicine is used for disinfection of the patient's skin before surgery and for disinfection of the patient's skin before insertion of a syringe needle or a catheter.
entries.이 약은 수술전 살균소독 (수술자 및 보건위생 종사자의 손소독)에 사용합: This medicine is used for bactericidal disinfection before surgery (hand disinfection of the operator and of health and hygiene workers).
This medicine is used for the sterilisation and disinfection of medical instruments.
entries.이 약은 인화성으로 담배불과 같은 발화성 물질로부터 멀리 보관하십시오.외: This medicine is flammable, so keep it away from ignition sources such as lit cigarettes. Use it externally only; it must not be swallowed.
entries.이 약은 치은염, 구내염, 아구창, 발치전·후, 인두염, 편도염, 방사선: This medicine is used to relieve gingivitis, stomatitis, thrush, conditions before and after tooth extraction, pharyngitis, tonsillitis, and oral mucositis caused by physical factors such as radiotherapy and intubation.
entries.이 약은 항균 피부 세정제로서, 일반 피부 및 피부 표면층보다 깊지 않은: This medicine is an antibacterial skin cleanser used for cleansing of general skin and of wounded areas no deeper than the surface layer of the skin, for personal hand disinfection, and for disinfection of the skin at the surgical site before surgery.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 이 약에 과민증 환자, 12세 미만의 소아는 의사: Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to it and children under 12 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms persist or worsen, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약의 약액이 흡수된 스폰지를 수술부위 또는 손과 팔꿈치까지 적용하여: Apply the sponge soaked with the solution of this medicine to the surgical site, or to the hands and up to the elbows, and rub by hand for 3 minutes. Rub the nails, the cuticles and the areas between the fingers with particular care, using a brush if necessary. Rinse with warm water, repeat the procedure washing for 3 minutes, rinse thoroughly with water and dry completely.
entries.일반 피부 및 상처부위 세정에는 세정할 부위를 물로 닦고, 피부나 상처에: For cleansing of general skin and wounded areas, wet the area to be cleansed with water, take only the minimum amount needed for application to the skin or wound, apply it, then wipe it off gently and rinse thoroughly with water. For hand disinfection during surgery, wet the hands and forearms with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and up to the elbows and rub for about 3 minutes using a brush or a sponge. Rinse thoroughly under running water, repeat the above procedure once more and then dry completely. For personal hand disinfection, wet the hands with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and rub both hands vigorously for 15 seconds. Rinse with water and dry completely. For disinfection of the skin before surgery, apply a sufficient amount to the surgical site and rub for at least 2 minutes. Dry with a sterile towel, repeat the above procedure once more and then dry with a sterile towel.
entries.일시적으로 자극감, 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐) 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉: If a temporary feeling of irritation or redness (congested and reddened skin) occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.제모제는 이 약 사용하기 전 또는 후로부터 12시간 이내에는 질환 부위에: Do not use depilatories on the affected area within 12 hours before or after using this medicine.
Cut it to a suitable size and apply it to the local area 1 to 2 times a day.
entries.클로르헥시딘에 과민증 환자, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성: Patients with hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, anyone who has experienced allergic symptoms (such as asthma) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine externally only. Do not use it on the head, the face, areas in contact with the meninges, the genital area, wounds deeper than the surface layer of the skin, the eyes, the ears, the mouth, extensive wounds or burns. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use.
entries.피부에 닿았을 경우 즉시 오염된 의복 등을 벗고, 흐르는 물로 충분히 씻: If it comes into contact with the skin, immediately remove the contaminated clothing and wash the area thoroughly with running water. If it gets into the eyes, immediately rinse them with running water for at least 15 minutes and then consult a doctor. If the vapour is inhaled, move immediately to a place with fresh air and then consult a doctor. If it is swallowed by mistake, immediately have the person drink a large amount of water or milk, do not force vomiting, and consult a doctor. During use and storage, use a container with a lid or similar to prevent the vapour from spreading, and at the same time take care to ventilate the area. Handle it with sufficient care, for example by wearing protective equipment such as goggles, so that it never gets into the eyes. Wash contaminated reusable devices thoroughly before disinfection. When disinfecting devices, wear gloves of an appropriate type and length, eye protection and a waterproof gown. Users must follow the instructions for use. Use a test strip to measure the concentration before use. After washing, remove the moisture thoroughly and then immerse the items in the prepared disinfectant solution. Repeated use may cause degradation of natural rubber and raw rubber, such as cracking. Do not use it on cracked or rusted instruments. During washing and disinfection, wear protective equipment such as rubber gloves, a gown, a mask and protective goggles to prevent contact with or inhalation of infectious material and of the disinfectant solution. Take sufficient care in storage and handling so that it is not drunk or swallowed by mistake.
entries.혈액공급이 불충분한 부위, 상처부위, 눈, 점막 및 궤양 부위에는 이 약: Do not use this medicine on areas with insufficient blood supply, on wounded areas, on the eyes, on mucous membranes or on ulcerated areas. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. When using it on a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use it topically on the skin only. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water.
